documents.title: Proposed plume-label notice excerpt (synthetic)
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Entirely fictional notice and docket: comments close twenty-two calendar days after reset on the date expressly stated in the notice. Use that stated date; do not infer a universal APA comment period. The coalition wants a small-cabinet label option. No real agency proposal is represented.

documents.title: Permit timing and cost worksheet (synthetic)
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. The cooperative also asks about a separate permit-review clock under 42 U.S.C. § 7661b(c), an authority the demo deadline catalog does not implement. No start event, applicable period, or due date has been verified. Needs verification: independently identify the applicable authority and agency record before calendaring. Label measurements are fictional sample data only.

deadlines.label: Submit comments by notice’s stated close date
Permit-review clock under 42 U.S.C. § 7661b(c) — Needs verification

trigger.event: Client raised an unverified permit-review timing question; not a verified statutory trigger

clientFacing.status: The comment deadline is stated in the notice. A separate permit timing question still needs independent verification.
nextSteps: Send photographs of the sample cabinet labels and the cost worksheet.
Approve the coalition comment before the stated close date.
Find the permit record so we can verify the separate timing question.
